meta.description: Track your grocery prices against Bulgarian retail chains.

dashboard.title: Price overview
dashboard.intro: How your catalog compares with competitor prices collected daily.

home.eyebrow: Daily price intelligence for Bulgarian grocers
home.title: Know where every price stands, every morning.
home.lead: PriceAI collects prices from {count} Bulgarian chains each night, matches them to your catalog and tells you which products to reprice.

preview.label: Example price comparison
preview.note: Example data. 2 of 3 competitors are cheaper.

steps.title: Collect
steps.text: Every night we read the official price feeds that large chains must publish by law.

steps.title: Match
steps.text: A keyword search shortlists candidate listings, then Gemini confirms which one is the same product.

steps.title: Label
steps.text: Each product gets a status so you see at a glance where to act.

competitive.name: Competitive
competitive.text: Your price is in line with the market.

opportunity.name: Opportunity
opportunity.text: You are cheaper than competitors and have room to raise the price.

at-risk.name: At risk
at-risk.text: Competitors sell the same product for less.

unmatched.name: Unmatched
unmatched.text: No competitor listing matched this product yet.

chains.title: Chains we track
chains.text: Prices come from each chain’s own feed or the KZP open-data archive, refreshed daily. All prices are in euro.

final.title: See your catalog against the market
final.text: Start with the dashboard and filter by the products that need attention.
